results.content: A big component of Trump's increase in net job approval over the past week is a rise in support from Independents, who rose from a net approval of -53 last week to -38 this week. But polling results for Independents can be particularly volatile, and Independents' approval of Trump remains in the range of his numbers with the group in recent months. [...] Donald Trump's popularity rebounded slightly in this week's Economist / YouGov Poll after his recent slump, but he remains deeply unpopular. This week's poll finds that 36% of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of Trump's job performance, and 57% disapprove — a net job approval of -21.
